responsibility: Declares the external interface of the Alpha backend implementation in alpha.cc for use by the machine description, headers, and other target code. The prototypes cover prologue/epilogue expansion, addressing and reload helpers, move and unaligned-memory expansion, varargs and calling convention support, atomics and compare-and-swap splitters, VMS-specific ABI helpers, operand predicates used from generated code, and constructors for the Alpha-specific RTL passes.
